run_fit_references_cli: run the fit_references script with --config and --out-path to fit linear element references
run_fit_linref_function: run fit_linref with a config dict and output path to fit and save linear references
fit_linear_references_from_dataset: fit linear references for target properties using a training dataset and element reference config
save_element_reference_checkpoint: save element reference state dicts as checkpoint files using save_checkpoint utility
load_config_for_fitting: load a YAML config file with load_config to get settings for fitting linear references
